# M5 FPGA history extraction verification

Date: 2026-10-27, Asia/Saigon. Scope: authorized M5 history extraction only. Policy: [M0 history strategy](../superpowers/plans/2026-10-24-multi-repo-migration-m0.md) and [verification guide](../VERIFICATION.md).

## Result and preserved boundaries

- Source: `f43f92c7730d40040e717bf1bacd3a3773e2a131` on `codex/m5-fpga-consumer`. Initial target: `aebac04f31f9af874b6cdff0da47b51ecfa16994` on `codex/m5-fpga-extract`. Filtered tip: `e0432905b7414a63eee4179983e47fa03d19dc49`.
- git-filter-repo **2.47.0**, installed only into the owned external session; fresh `git clone --no-local`, without `--force`.
- **5 retained commits / 127 mappings**. Exact Git mode/type/blob/path parity holds for all 15 selected tip entries and every retained commit, including absence of unexpected output paths. Raw author/committer identity, epoch timestamp and timezone lines match for every retained mapping.
- All **15 historic selected file paths**, including deleted-name inventory, were checked with `git log --all --follow --name-status`. No excluded predecessor path was found.
- Source and target original refs, HEADs and indexes remained unchanged across extraction/restoration checks. Initial Git status and staged diffs were clean. Separate concurrent M5 product work is outside this history task and is not backed up by committed-ref bundles.
- No authored commit, merge, stage, push, force push, original-history rewrite, source deletion, target product edit, or M6 work. Filter-generated commits exist only in the temporary clone and durable filtered bundle.
- Initial target ancestry and extracted ancestry remain separate. Connecting them requires a separately authorized merge/commit; a snapshot alone does not connect ancestry.

## Exact path mapping and mixed-test provenance

The extraction retains original prefixes: `fpga/**` → `fpga/**`; `tests/fpga/**` → `tests/fpga/**`; `.github/workflows/fpga.yml` and `LICENSE` retain their paths. No path rename or content rewrite is applied.

The historical `tests/fpga/test_lab_first_control.py` blob deliberately remains whole: it contains both RTL/scaffold assertions and a Hardware transport assertion. This is historical provenance, not a claim that Hardware transport belongs to FPGA. The active standalone FPGA product excludes that transport test; Hardware owns those assertions. Product adaptations to consume pinned Contracts and run standalone are ordinary uncommitted changes, separate from this exact history bundle. The full source archive anchors original surrounding context.

## Durable archives and restoration

All archives and metadata are retained outside repository/worktree/Git directories under the authorized durable archive directory. Temporary tooling, clones and raw logs were created directly inside the allocator-owned `netcircuit-m5` session with all five participating roots and TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR/cache paths inherited.

Each bundle passed `git bundle verify`, a fresh actual `git clone --mirror --no-local BUNDLE EXTERNAL_RESTORE.git`, exact full `git show-ref` map equality, expected HEAD, `git cat-file -e` for every advertised tip, and `git fsck --full --strict` (exit 0, no fsck diagnostics). Source custom refs include tree objects and long names; validation does not assume all tips are commits.

The first restoration harness incorrectly treated the bundle-advertised `worktrees/Multi-Repo/HEAD` pseudo-ref as a `refs/*` named ref. The corrected gate compares every actual named ref from `show-ref` and checks every advertised object, including HEAD and linked-worktree pseudo-HEAD tips; all three final restorations were performed afresh. Linked-worktree administration is not recreated by a mirror clone. Their advertised commit objects remain in the archive and were verified.

Raw follow/extraction/restoration logs, bundle headers, metadata and strict fsck results were inspected. No browser, visual or physical hardware execution is involved. Parent migration work coordinates guarded cleanup of the shared owned session after all consumers finish; durable bundles/provenance/commit-map lie outside that cleanup scope.

## Reproduction and limits

Create source and target-before archives with `git bundle create ABSOLUTE_BUNDLE --all`. In a fresh external `--no-local` source clone, run:

```text
python SESSION/history-tools/git_filter_repo.py --path fpga/ --path tests/fpga/ --path .github/workflows/fpga.yml --path LICENSE
```

Filtering changes commit IDs, prunes unrelated commits and may simplify topology. The original repository and full source archive remain provenance anchors. Bundle/restore/tree/identity/follow checks: **PASS**. `python scripts/check_markdown.py`: **PASS** (191 files, zero errors; external URLs not fetched). `git diff --check`: **PASS**. Fresh index/ignored-file inventories found no staged changes or added ignored files from this history task. This report does not establish runtime, synthesis, timing, CDC, electrical or physical capability acceptance.
